content.title: Long-term management after acute coronary syndrome (ACS)
content.figure: Figure 17: Long-term management after acute coronary syndrome
discharge_actions: Arrange outpatient department (OPD) review to manage comorbidities and discuss patient goals and preferences

2_continue_optimal_pharmacological_and_c: Other pharmacological treatments as appropriate (see recommendation table referenced)

3_reach_and_sustain_risk_factor_treatmen.blood_pressure: Systolic BP <130 mmHg and diastolic BP <80 mmHg (if tolerated)
3_reach_and_sustain_risk_factor_treatmen.hba1c: HbA1c <53 mmol/mol (<7%) (for patients with diabetes mellitus)

age_and_special_population_notes: For patients ≥70 years of age the systolic blood pressure target should be <140 mmHg and may be reduced to 130 mmHg if tolerated
HbA1c target shown applies to patients with diabetes mellitus
source_notes: Figure and targets are presented as long-term treatment goals after ACS
Footnotes reference other recommendation tables for additional pharmacological treatments
